basic_profile.bio: A 33-year-old animation enthusiast from Dunedin, New Zealand. I work as a freelance graphic designer and spend my free time exploring unique animation styles and cartoons from around the world. I'm a night owl, often online between 9 PM and 2 AM NZDT. In a committed relationship with my partner of 5 years, we share a love for uncovering obscure media. Dislike overly commercialized content and adore indie and under-the-radar shows.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Fine Arts with a specialization in Animation from Otago Polytechnic. Over the years, I've honed my expertise in animation through self-teaching and professional experience as a freelancer. My interests span both Western and Eastern animation styles, and I've developed a keen eye for spotting unique storytelling techniques.
